trigger.description: ee.cache.hotset.v1 manifest is built from captured search/pack hotset entries whose generation is older than the current workspace and index generation. The manifest rejects them instead of admitting silently stale candidates, and surfaces this degraded code so an operator chooses to recapture.
trigger.invocation: Build a HotsetManifest via HotsetManifestBuilder against a GenerationGate whose generations exceed the supplied entries' generations.

message_contains: entries older than the current generation
expected_emission.repair_contains: Recapture the hotset against the current
expected_emission.repair_string: Recapture the hotset against the current workspace and index generation.
